decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. For the next 4 weeks, Cobalt savings earn an extra 0.5 points on balances up to $50,000. For 4 weeks your Cobalt debit card earns 1%, up to $5 cash back. We are adding a $5 credit to your account to thank you for your patience.

actions.action: Free replacement card on request and payment alerts

decisions.message: On Sat Dec 12, 00:00 to Sun Dec 13, about 12:00 Central, we move to a new banking system: your balance stays visible, but transfers, P2P payments and new cards pause. It may run some hours longer; we will post updates in the app. We have added 50 support staff for the coming weeks. You can order a free new card at any time, and we now send an alert for every card payment. During the system move, card payments work offline up to $250 each (raised from $100).
decisions.why:

Cost $650,000 of the $4M budget.
